scientific.integrity: The all-set criterion is proved by a complete classification of nonempty skew-stalled white sets. The polynomial, minimum-set count, and failed number are direct consequences. A separate exhaustive simulator checks every initial subset through order 18.
limitations: The theorem concerns the standard skew color-change rule on the ordinary book graph B_n=K_{1,n} square P_2.
The finite verifier is a stress test only; the arbitrary-n statement rests on the symbolic stalled-set proof.
Focused source and semantic-index searches cannot exclude every unindexed source or alternate book-graph terminology.

title: All skew zero forcing sets of book graphs
